name: informatica-etl-conversion
description: Convert Informatica PowerCenter mappings into Snowflake or Databricks pipelines: import PowerCenter XML exports with toolkit ds collect etl, build lineage, and decompose the estate into ordered scored migration waves with ds migration-plan, then convert each plan group through toolkit agent etl-extract, agent discovery with a grouped human-review queue, and agent pipeline-build. A small number of mappings can skip the assessment and convert in a single pass.
